final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped), above_average AS (SELECT share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT COALESCE(SUM((SELECT member_count FROM grouped WHERE grouped.link_to_major = (SELECT link_to_major FROM grouped LIMIT 1))), 0) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
